description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Zone' within the Opencart admin module, responsible for managing localisation zones. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, and deleting zones, along with data handling, permission checks, and URL/link generation.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Controller class for managing localisation zones in the OpenCart admin interface, providing CRUD operations, status toggling, and listing functionality.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the zone list page, setting up necessary data and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of zones, mainly called via AJAX or internal navigation, by invoking getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares zone data with filtering, sorting, pagination, and generates the view for listing zones.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a zone, loading existing data if available.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating a zone, including validation and permissions.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected zones by changing their status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected zones by changing their status to inactive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected zones after various checks for dependencies and permissions.
